Chat limits keep agents from getting overwhelmed by chats, especially during high traffic. Experienced agents can help clear the queue faster with the Hybrid Assignment Mode. Enable Reassignments and Automatic Idle to reduce visitor wait time by preventing chats from getting assigned to inactive agents.
